articles.title: Stealth frigate INS Trishul takes part in bilateral naval exercise 'Varuna' in France
articles.description: The Indian Navy's stealth frigate INS Trishul has taken part in the flagship bilateral naval exercise 'Varuna' in France. The move aims to strengthen maritime and professional ties between the two countries. INS Trishul is the second ship of the Talwar-class …
